full_details: At the Theatre in the morning Edith had the thread, and she was paid when the work is in the hand, not by a new sum today. Arthur said the hem let down at Easter is already short. You did not hurry the tale. At two you played Errors. They heard it. You called that worse than noise. Margery did not give you a new box, and she kept Tuesday's nine where she had said it. Garnish is still in the middle of the king and would not report a page. At home you brought Brooke forward and left it unopened. Holinshed is still Field's. No line of the new play was written.
one_sentence: You saw Edith finish a cuff and heard Arthur on his shins, then played the old man's tale again, and again the yard heard every word.
title: The old man, heard through
